DARV.talk.GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CHARACTER_CH:
Ah... a visitor from beyond. Your shadow arrived before you.
Don't touch that book. It remembers names.
Back again? Or is something deeper looking at me through your eyes?
NEOW.talk.GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CHARACTER_CH:
...Wake... no, don't wake...
The thing beyond the door has heard your heartbeat...
...You are not fleeing fate... but the eye that watches you...
NONUPEIPE.talk.GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CHARACT:
There is a noise in you that does not belong here.
It arranges stars inside your bones.
Do not answer that voice. It will continue speaking with yours.
OROBAS.talk.GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CHARACTER_: I see the shape you had, and the shape you will lose.
Every treasure waits for a master. Some masters wait to be opened.
PAEL.talk.GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CHARACTER_CH: You came from the far side of starlight. There are no roads there, only forgotten directions.
If you hear the song below, pretend it is not your name.
TANX.talk.GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CHARACTER_CH: Hey, stranger! Did your shadow just blink?
Don't worry, I didn't see what was behind you... probably.
TEZCATARA.talk.GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CHARACT: You carry unfinished causes. They are devouring one another behind you.
Do not let the door know that you have learned how to open it.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CHA: You flee control, yet still walk the path I designed.
Curious. A prisoner claiming to be an author, searching for an unwritten exit.
VAKUU.talk.GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CHARACTER_C: Your soul is like paper soaked through. The words upon it are still moving.
If you wish to escape, do not look back. Those who do will see they never left.
